description: Built-in (calm): read a short, scannable draft or report (safe Markdown subset or plain text) and approve it, or request changes with an overall comment. Sections can carry their own comment (shown on hover/focus). No raw HTML. Markdown http(s) links open in the system browser. Images only through the media field. Code blocks, quotes and an optional copy list can be copied. A quote that starts with [!NOTE], [!TIP], [!IMPORTANT], [!WARNING] or [!CAUTION] is a quiet callout with a title and no copy.
